Estrategia.headline: We build the commercial strategy that turns hotels into stronger, more profitable brands ready to <serif>sell better.</serif>
Estrategia.item1Body1: We organize rates, channels, inventory and commercial positioning so the hotel sells with more predictability and less dependence on OTAs.
Estrategia.item1Body2: This pillar matters because a solid distribution strategy avoids sales without margin, improves occupancy control and helps the hotel make decisions based on demand, seasons and channels.
Estrategia.item2Body1: We create professional content to strengthen the hotel's online presence, spark desire and turn social media into part of the commercial strategy.
Estrategia.item2Body2: More than posting for aesthetics, content needs to communicate value, answer questions, present experiences and bring the guest closer to a direct booking.
Estrategia.item3Body1: We plan campaigns on Google, Meta, Hotel Ads and SEO connected to the commercial calendar, the packages and the hotel's sales goals.
Estrategia.item3Body2: This pillar is essential to attract qualified demand, work remarketing, promote strategic offers and turn visibility into real booking opportunities.
Estrategia.item4Body1: We structure multichannel service with active selling, follow-up, commercial standardization and tracking of the opportunities generated.
Estrategia.item4Body2: Because receiving contacts is not enough: you need to respond fast, lead the conversation, recover quotes, offer upgrades and turn interest into a confirmed booking.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: Growth Hotel Solutions provides outsourced commercial operations for hotels in Brazil. This policy explains, plainly, what personal data we process on this site, what we use it for, and what your rights are under Brazil’s General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018 — LGPD).
Privacy.s1Intro: This site collects personal data at a single point: the “let’s talk” contact form. The data is what you enter yourself:
s1Items: Name — the name you type into the form.
Contact channel — how you choose to reach us: WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram or e-mail.
Contact details — the number, username or e-mail address for the channel you chose.
Privacy.s1Outro: We do not ask for tax IDs, addresses, payment details or any category of sensitive personal data. Outside that form, the site neither requests nor stores personal data.
Privacy.s2Body: Solely to reply to you and schedule the commercial diagnosis you requested. We do not use this data for unsolicited marketing, and we do not sell, rent or trade it with third parties for commercial purposes.
Privacy.s3Body: Processing of form data rests on the data subject’s consent (LGPD art. 7, I): you freely choose to fill in and submit the form so that we contact you. Should we adopt audience analytics tools, processing may rest on legitimate interest (art. 7, IX) or on consent, as applicable and always on an informed basis.
Privacy.s4Intro: Data submitted through the form is recorded in a Google Sheet. The submission is sent from our own server, not from your browser.
Privacy.s4Body: This means Google acts as a processor of that data and that it may be stored on servers located outside Brazil. Such international transfer takes place under LGPD arts. 33 and following. There are no other recipients: we do not share your data with partners, advertisers or ad networks.
Privacy.s5Body: We keep form data for as long as needed to handle your enquiry and, where a commercial relationship exists, for the period required by applicable law. You may request deletion at any time via the e-mail below.
Privacy.s6Body: The form is submitted over an encrypted connection (HTTPS) and processed on the server, not in the browser. Access to the sheet where data is recorded is restricted to the Growth Hotel Solutions team. No system is infallible, but we apply reasonable measures proportionate to the volume and nature of the data processed.
Privacy.s7Body: This site does not currently use analytics cookies or audience measurement tools. We may adopt Google Analytics or an equivalent solution to understand how the site is used and improve it. If that happens, this policy will be updated and, where required, a cookie notice with the option to decline will be shown.
Privacy.s8Title: Your rights as a data subject
Privacy.s8Intro: The LGPD grants you, as the data subject, the following rights:
s8Items: Confirmation that we process your data, and access to it.
Correction of incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data.
Anonymisation, blocking or deletion of data that is unnecessary or processed unlawfully.
Portability of your data to another provider, upon express request.
Deletion of data processed on the basis of your consent.
Information about the entities with which we share your data.
Withdrawal of consent at any time.
Privacy.s9Body: Write to <mail></mail>. We will reply as soon as we can. For your protection, we may ask for additional information confirming your identity before acting on the request.
Privacy.s10Body: We may update this policy to reflect changes to the site or to the law. The last-updated date at the top of this page always indicates the version in force.
